grammar:
char ::= [^"\\\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
ref-defs-DirectionProposal ::= "{" space ref-defs-DirectionProposal-title-kv "," space ref-defs-DirectionProposal-approach-kv "," space ref-defs-DirectionProposal-contrast-kv space "}"
ref-defs-DirectionProposal-approach ::= "\"" char{20} char* "\""
ref-defs-DirectionProposal-approach-kv ::= "\"approach\"" space ":" space ref-defs-DirectionProposal-approach
ref-defs-DirectionProposal-contrast ::= "\"" char+ "\""
ref-defs-DirectionProposal-contrast-kv ::= "\"contrast\"" space ":" space ref-defs-DirectionProposal-contrast
ref-defs-DirectionProposal-title ::= "\"" char+ "\""
ref-defs-DirectionProposal-title-kv ::= "\"title\"" space ":" space ref-defs-DirectionProposal-title
response-format-schema ::= "{" space response-format-schema-directions-kv "," space response-format-schema-uncertainties-kv space "}"
response-format-schema-directions ::= "[" space response-format-schema-directions-item ("," space response-format-schema-directions-item){0,5} space "]"
response-format-schema-directions-item ::= ref-defs-DirectionProposal
response-format-schema-directions-kv ::= "\"directions\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-directions
response-format-schema-uncertainties ::= "[" space (response-format-schema-uncertainties-item ("," space response-format-schema-uncertainties-item){0,5})? space "]"
response-format-schema-uncertainties-item ::= "\"" char* "\""
response-format-schema-uncertainties-kv ::= "\"uncertainties\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-uncertainties
root ::= response-format-schema
space ::= [ \t\n\r]*

transformation.changed: Defer only sampler string maxLength; retain all complete source schema bytes and SHA binding
transformation.unchanged: JSON types, exact keys, required members, enum, string minLength and every array minItems/maxItems
transformation.method: Deterministic GBNF for the exact collection-direction proposal schema; per-item minimums and 1..6 proposal / 0..6 uncertainty bounds are retained.
transformation.length_scope: Only string maxLength is omitted from sampler GBNF to avoid the installed 6703d7894 repetition parser boundary. String minLength and all array minItems/maxItems remain enforced by this grammar. The complete original schema, text system/prompt and host Pydantic retain every string maximum; overlong responses must be rejected without truncation or repair.
transformation.input_scope: Text-only artistic collection proposals. The host allocates each item separately; schema and plan do not certify understanding, distinct images, quality or user approval.
transformation.source_runtime_scope: Shared installed DLL diagnostic reference, not a completed direction-plan inference receipt.
